title: Welcome to ARTEPOOL
subtitle: This is the first-run setup of the server PC. It is done once only.
windows10: This PC runs Windows 10, which no longer gets free security updates from Microsoft. Upgrading to Windows 11, or buying Microsoft's extended updates, is advised. You can continue the setup as usual.

new.title: New setup
new.text: First time: enter the company details and your account, and enroll this PC as the point of sale.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.text: A new server PC instead of a broken or stolen one: bring back all the data from a backup.

company.title: Company details
company.subtitle: These are printed on every tax invoice. You can change them later in Settings.
company.logoHint: A PNG or JPEG picture, up to 512 KB.
company.logoType: Choose a PNG or JPEG picture only.
company.logoSize: The picture is larger than 512 KB.

owner.title: Your owner account
owner.subtitle: The only account made here. Add the other staff later in Settings → Users.
owner.usernameHint: Small English letters and digits, for example mohammed.
owner.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
owner.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
owner.invalidUsername: The username has 3 to 32 characters: small English letters, digits, dots or dashes only.

device.title: This PC
device.subtitle: This PC is enrolled as a point of sale, so the cashier can sell on it.
device.name: PC name
device.codeHint: A short name in English letters, for example POS-01.

finish.title: One step left
finish.subtitle: Everything is ready. Press Finish to close the first-run setup for good.

done.title: Setup is done
done.subtitle: Now sign in with your username, password and phone code.
